description: This file defines the AuthenticationProvider interface, which specifies methods for authenticating requests within the security package of the gateway service. It declares an isApplicable method to determine if the provider applies to a given request, and an authenticate method that performs the asynchronous authentication process, returning a CompletableFuture of the result.

classes.name: AuthenticationProvider
classes.description: This interface defines the contract for authentication providers, parameterized over the authentication result type R.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks whether this authentication provider is suitable for the given request context.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs the authentication asynchronously using the request context and headers, returning a CompletableFuture containing the authentication result.
